title: From a RISC-V Instruction to Pipeline Execution
subject: Computer Architecture
description: Trace an RV32I ADD instruction through encoding, the five-stage datapath, forwarding, stalls, control hazards, and performance.
outcomes: Decode the fields of an RV32I R-type instruction
Trace data and control through a five-stage pipeline
Explain forwarding, stalls, flushing, latency, and throughput
